rationale: Builds on the best reverse-tail recurrent family with a compact structural change instead of another scalar sweep. The recurrence anchor is no longer frozen across the reverse tail pass: each recurrent block now gets a learned anchor-refresh gate with a small floor, so the carry path can progressively refresh toward the current recurrent state while preserving shape stability, quant-aware training, and the existing export path. This targets a still-live local idea category around reverse-tail anchor variants without bloating the script or touching evaluation semantics.
title: Reverse-Tail Anchor Refresh Gate
